    perf: widen nongated MoE activation stores
    
    Join converted FC1 halves in an integer carrier so packed FP4 and FP8 output stores use their full supported width without local-memory lowering. Preserve scale arithmetic and the existing fused atomic path.
    
    Validated 104 N3U EP/TP cells with paired CUPTI runs: quantized prefill improves 3.14% geometric mean; decode is neutral. Existing exact and native-resource checks pass.
